annotations.title: Has anyone started reporting this number?

description: Use when the user asks whether any company, or which of a named set of competitors, now reports a figure (a franchise share, ARPU, a retention rate, a concentration, a multiple), or whether a public comparable discloses the metric a deal model depends on. Returns, from SEC EDGAR full-text search, which filers use the phrase in their filings over the years given, with the first and latest filing linked; for named peers, who does, who does not, and who could not be measured because they filed nothing. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/disclosure-check.json

end.description: Last year. At most 10 years per run.

peers.description: Optional: 2-10 tickers, comma-separated, from: PEP, KO, K, POST, KDP, CELH, UTZ, HRL, GIS, KHC, CAG, CPB, HSY, MDLZ, SJM, CLX, CL, CHD, PG, SMPL, BRBR, MSFT, EA, TTWO, RBLX, OMC, STGW, CRM, HUBS, TDOC, TALK, GDDY, GEN, NFLX, AMZN. Omit to search all filers.

phrase.description: The phrase to measure, without quote marks.

start.description: First year. Default: two years ago.
